title:
Triggered when View Preview Experiment Model Model is Opened.

This Epic will poll the {@link ReliabilityMlModelExperiment#workflowRun} status and
every 3 second, until redirected to different page, or the workflow is completed or failed.

It will set {@link ModelConfigApplicationState#experimentModelStatus} and {@link ModelExperimentApplicationState#experimentModelStatus} to
the current status of the workflow.
